Entries record what was **measured**, not what was intended, and clip
enough of the experimental apparatus to re-run the test rather than
merely its conclusion.

These 145 entries were a separate repository until `weftspun/logbook`
was archived. A decision and its measurement sat one repository apart;
they no longer do. Entries kept their filenames, so an entry is still
findable by the thing it measured rather than by where it used to live.
